name: balcony
description: Balcony (阳台): two variants from one generator — cantilever (悬空挑板式: deck projecting from the facade, held by upside-down stair corbels under the wall line [support=brackets] and/or fence columns down from the front corners [support=columns], railing wrapping the three free edges) and recessed (凹进式/loggia: the balcony carved INTO the facade — the generator emits the recess shell: back wall, jambs, floor, lintel, threshold, plus explicit air cells that carve the recess out of an existing wall, with a railing at the front lip). Optional doorway punched through the facade/back wall (air carve). wall_stub emits the facade patch so the piece is self-supporting. All direction states (corbel stair facing/half, trapdoor open panels) are DERIVED from origin+facing.
when_to_use: Upper-floor facade relief: houses, inns, apartments, keeps — a bare flat wall above the ground floor is exactly the '光秃秃' failure this card fixes. origin = bottom-LEFT cell of the wall face (seen from OUTSIDE), y = the balcony FLOOR layer (align it with the interior upper floor); facing = the outward direction the balcony looks to. Common sizes: width 3-5, depth 1-2 (cantilever max 3; more reads as a roof deck, not a balcony). DIRECTION STATES ARE DERIVED BY THE SCRIPT — never hand-edit (禁止手改方向状态).
use_for: 二层立面挑阳台/凹阳台(敞廊);民居、客栈、公寓、塔楼立面分层;配 window_trim/pilaster 做立面节奏

variant.notes: cantilever=悬空挑板;recessed=凹进立面(敞廊)

origin.notes: 墙面外视左下角格;y=阳台地板层(对齐室内楼板)

facing.notes: 阳台外朝向;一切朝向状态由此推导

floor_material.notes: 甲板/凹阳台地面;石构用 stone_brick_slab 风格请给整砖

wall_material.notes: 墙贴面/凹阳台壳体;与真实墙面同料以便咬合

wall_stub.notes: cantilever:发出阳台所挂的墙面补丁(与真墙重叠是刻意的);recessed 壳体恒发

stub_height.notes: cantilever 墙补丁在甲板以上的层数(盖住门洞上沿)

railing.notes: 栏杆做法(详见 railing 卡);trapdoor=木面板栏板

railing_material.notes: 按 railing 校验后缀:fence=*_fence, wall=*_wall, pane=*_pane|iron_bars, trapdoor=*_trapdoor

post_spacing.notes: pane 栏杆每隔几格一根柱

support.notes: cantilever 支撑:brackets=托臂(倒放楼梯),columns=前角柱落地,none=纯悬挑(现代)

corbel_material.notes: 托臂;half=top 倒放、平托面朝上顶住甲板(脚本推导)

column_drop.notes: 立柱从甲板前角向下延伸层数;必须落到地面/下层屋顶,给错就是悬空柱

door.notes: 开 1x2 门洞(air 开凿);cantilever 开在墙补丁上,recessed 开在凹进后墙上

pitfalls: 悬挑阳台没有支撑是'浮空板'——support=none 只用于现代风格;brackets 托臂是倒放楼梯(half=top、平托面顶住甲板),不是正放
栏杆立在甲板边缘格的正上方,不是贴在甲板外侧壁那一列(那列浮空且挡门);凹进式栏杆在门槛排上沿
column_drop 必须真实落地(地面/下层屋面);柱子停在半空比没有更糟
门洞是 air 开凿格,放阳台前确认门洞位置对着室内走道,不要对着床/柜子
depth 别贪大:挑阳台 1-2 最自然,3 是极限;更深请做屋顶平台(平台+ railing 卡)
阳台底(甲板下表面)别漏:brackets 行就是给底面收边的;support=columns 时甲板下保持干净别乱塞方块
一层阳台别贴地放:origin y 应对齐二层楼板;贴地的'阳台'是门廊(porch),请用柱子+顶
与真墙合并时跑 collision_check(墙补丁/壳体与既有墙体同坐标属刻意重叠,材质必须一致)
example: python patterns/balcony.py --params '{"variant":"cantilever","origin":[100,64,100],"facing":"south","width":4,"depth":2}' --out balcony1.json && python patterns/balcony.py --params '{"variant":"recessed","origin":[100,64,120],"facing":"east","width":3,"depth":1,"railing":"pane","railing_material":"minecraft:glass_pane"}' --out balcony2.json
